title: Study on the detection of water status of tomato ( Solanum lycopersicum L.) by multimodal deep learning.
summary: A multimodal deep-learning model fuses RGB, NIR and depth images to classify five tomato water-status levels under controlled irrigation; held-out testing and single-modality comparisons are reported. This establishes a bounded crop-stress sensing result, not field irrigation benefit.
